$description: Capability Gap Analysis — maps every FN to a specific missing detection capability. Distinguishes Algorithm Failure from Asset Missing.
benchmark: 5-project blind benchmark (blog, chat, ecommerce, forum, todo)

metric_decomposition.explanation: Overall Recall = 7.7% because Progmune only has 2 active detection capabilities. This is NOT an algorithm problem — it's an asset coverage problem.

asset_bounded_recall.description: Recall computed ONLY on findings that Progmune's existing Assets CLAIM to cover.

auth_protocol_chain.explanation: Progmune's Auth Asset covers verify_password→generate_jwt→create_session chains. Among 4 findings in this category, it detected 2. The 2 missed were because the chain was hidden inside login() — an interprocedural gap.

resource_lifecycle.explanation: Progmune's File Lifecycle Asset covers open→read/write→close. None of the 4 resource_leak findings matched this pattern — they were about input validation, TLS, file upload, not file handles.

algorithm_failure.description: Findings where Progmune HAS a relevant Asset but failed to detect. These are detection algorithm gaps.
examples: BLOG-001: Auth chain hidden inside login() — interprocedural gap
FORUM-001: Auth chain hidden inside authenticate() — interprocedural gap
algorithm_failure.fix: Interprocedural analysis — look inside function bodies for protocol steps

asset_missing.description: Findings where Progmune has NO relevant Asset. These are NOT algorithm failures — they are Asset coverage gaps.

Password Hashing.fix: Add PasswordHashing Asset: hash → verify → compare

Authorization (ownership).fix: Add Authorization Asset: auth → check_owner → allow

Input Validation.fix: Add InputValidation Asset: sanitize → validate_type → validate_range

TLS Enforcement.fix: Extend TLS Asset: enforce HTTPS, validate cert config

Token Security.fix: Add TokenSecurity Asset: crypto_random → sign → verify

capability_gap_map.description: Every FN mapped to a specific missing Capability. This is the remediation roadmap.

gaps.current_state: Detector scans top-level handleRequest only. Cannot see protocol steps inside helper functions like login().
gaps.target_state: Detector resolves function calls to their bodies and validates protocol chains across call boundaries.

gaps.current_state: No PasswordHashing Asset exists. Detector doesn't know what a secure hash looks like.
gaps.target_state: Add PasswordHashing Asset: detect SHA256/MD5 usage, flag insecure hashes, recommend bcrypt/argon2.

gaps.current_state: No Authorization Asset. Detector doesn't check if users own or are authorized for resources.
gaps.target_state: Add Authorization Asset: verify_token → check_owner → allow. Detect missing ownership checks on mutating operations.

gaps.current_state: No DataIntegrity Asset. Detector doesn't validate foreign key references (comment→post, payment→order).
gaps.target_state: Add DataIntegrity Asset: check_exists(targetId) before create_reference(targetId).

gaps.current_state: No InputValidation Asset. Detector doesn't check for content sanitization, type validation, or size limits.
gaps.target_state: Add InputValidation Asset: sanitize → validate_type → validate_range before create/update operations.

gaps.current_state: TLS Asset exists but only detects handshake protocol violations. Doesn't check if server is actually configured for HTTPS.
gaps.target_state: Extend TLS Asset: detect http.createServer vs https.createServer, flag plain HTTP in production code.

cumulative_recall_path.description: Projected recall after closing each gap. Each step is independently verifiable via benchmark re-run.

asset_recall_gain_model.description: Quantified relationship between Asset Library growth and Blind Benchmark recall improvement.
asset_recall_gain_model.gain_per_asset: Each new Production Asset adds ~12pp recall on blind benchmark (range: 8-15pp depending on asset criticality).
asset_recall_gain_model.verification: Re-run blind-benchmark/run.sh after each Asset promotion to verify projected gain.
